{{Quote|To the north lies a deep-cut canyon. At the end of it you will find ruins: all that is left of dark Kabus-Dabeh. They are the remannts of an ancient and evil people. You must go there. One of our bravest protectors has placed a ''skuhm''-hid bag of metal coins somewhere in the ruin. You must find this bag and return it here. If you persevere, you will prove your worth. If you do not, we will not regard you as an honorable negotiator.|Chief clansman|<ref name="RoKD ">{{WEGCite|story=Ruins of Kabus-Dabeh|book=Tales of the Jedi Companion}}</ref>}}
The '''chief clansman''' was a high-ranking member of the [[Muza]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Muzara]].<ref name="RoKD " /> Circa [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]],<ref name="CSWE II 346">{{CSWECite|II|346|Muzara}}</ref> the chief clansman and his tribe were involved in a dispute with [[Human/Legends|Human]] settlers from the [[Brentaal League]]. When a Human [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] named [[Keval Raffaan]] arrived and offered to broker a settlement between the rival groups, the chief clansman informed the Jedi that he would first have to prove his worthiness by retrieving a ''[[skuhm]]''-[[Leather/Legends|leather]] bag of [[Coin/Legends|coins]] placed by a Muza [[bravest protector]] in the ruins of [[Kabus-Dabeh]]. The Jedi accepted.<ref name="RoKD " />
